decision: M03c ORAS level-up learnsets and Gen 5 move data, approved 2026-09-11

learnset_audit.method: Level-up learnsets are a whole-file swap in src/pokemon.c; resolved the Fairy-typed roster against each candidate file in src/data/pokemon/level_up_learnsets/.
learnset_audit.why_not_gen_5: At Gen 5 learnsets only Sylveon learns a Fairy attacking move, because Sylveon post-dates B2W2 and falls back to its Gen 6 data. Clefable, Gardevoir, Azumarill, Togekiss, Whimsicott, Mawile, Granbull, Wigglytuff and the rest learn none. TMs cannot compensate: include/constants/tms_hms.h still holds the vanilla Emerald 50 TMs and 8 HMs, which contain no Fairy move and no Gen 4 or Gen 5 move.
learnset_audit.remaining_six_at_gen_6: AZURILL, CLEFFA, IGGLYBUFF, MIME_JR and TOGEPI are babies that evolve into a species that has one; TOGEKISS has none of its own but carries Fairy Wind up from Togetic, which learns it at 14.
learnset_audit.owner_exception: MR_MIME was the only final-stage Fairy species left with no Fairy attacking move. Given MOVE_DAZZLING_GLEAM at level 44 in level_up_learnsets/gen_6.h, matching the level it learns it in the present-day games.

examples: Reversed later buffs: Vine Whip 45 -> 35, Pin Missile 25 -> 14, Skull Bash 130 -> 100
move_data_audit.safety_check: No selector's Gen 5 branch resolves to zero power, accuracy or PP, so no move is broken. No Fairy move carries a move-data selector that GEN_5 reaches; Moonblast, Dazzling Gleam, Play Rough, Disarming Voice, Draining Kiss and Fairy Wind are literals.
move_data_audit.not_changed: B_UPDATED_MOVE_FLAGS is deliberately left at GEN_LATEST. It is a separate open choice; setting it to GEN_5 would, among other things, remove sound moves' ability to bypass Substitute.

limits: One test assertion initially failed because the helper returns the first level a move is learned and Gardevoir learns Moonblast twice; the assertion was corrected to a unique level and no production data was changed
Static resolution plus runtime assertions over sampled species and moves; not an exhaustive per-species learnset or per-move historical audit
The TM/HM list is still vanilla Emerald's 50 TMs and 8 HMs, with no Gen 4, Gen 5 or Fairy move. That is a pre-existing gap, unrelated to this decision and still unaddressed
B_UPDATED_MOVE_FLAGS, species experience yields and breeding rules remain inherited and unapproved
Weather-setter abilities and the restored move power both change battle pacing; no trainer or gym team has been designed or rebalanced around either
The existing linker RWX warning is unchanged; this is not a warning-free or release certification
No full playthrough, menu pass or five-region progression balance
